title: Ruthenium-anchored zirconium dioxide derived from a metal–organic framework as a highly efficient pH-universal electrocatalyst for hydrogen evolution
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2026, 10,897-904
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE01592H, Paper
Liyun Cao, Wenchao Li, Jianfeng Huang, Dewei Chu, Yijun Liu, Faliang Luo, Xuemeng Huo, Dongping Wang, Yongqiang Feng
This Ru nanoparticle catalyst demonstrates excellent HER activity across the full pH range, with performance enhancement attributed to the electronic interaction between Ru and the support.
